commit_message: Fix inconsistent styling on preset and action buttons
title: 🎨 Palette: [Make button styling consistent]
description:
💡 **What:** Standardized the styling of the 'Strong Uber Day', 'Calculate', and 'Save result' buttons to match the dark neutral style (`.secondary`) of the other preset and action buttons.
🎯 **Why:** To fix a visual inconsistency reported by the user where three buttons incorrectly used a bright green style, conflicting with the established neutral button design pattern in the 'Presets and actions' section.
📸 **Before/After:** The three buttons now use the `.secondary` CSS class instead of `.blue`, aligning with the rest of the dark UI theme.
♿ **Accessibility:** The dark neutral buttons maintain high contrast text and include existing hover/focus states, ensuring continued accessibility and keyboard navigation support without introducing custom CSS.
